plan.cover_image_prompt: reception desk of a local medical clinic, appointment scheduling moment, warm indoor light, realistic photo, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The learner is contacting a local clinic reception to book a doctor's appointment because they have had a sore throat and fever for three days. They need to explain the reason briefly and choose a suitable time.
Learner: the patient. Partner: the receptionist.
Learner must be able to: say they want to make an appointment; briefly explain that they have a sore throat and a fever for three days; ask about the nearest available time; choose a suitable appointment time.
Partner will: ask what the problem is; offer available times or days; confirm the booking details.
Not in this scene: describing symptoms in detail, answering medical questions, diagnosis, treatment instructions.
scenes.image_prompt: clinic reception desk with appointment calendar and computer, patient arranging a visit, realistic photo, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The learner is at the doctor's appointment after booking it at the clinic. They need to explain that their throat has been hurting and they have had a fever for three days, answer simple questions, and understand basic advice.
Learner: the patient. Partner: the doctor.
Learner must be able to: describe the main symptoms in simple words; say how long the sore throat and fever have lasted; answer basic questions about temperature and pain; understand simple advice and ask for repetition if needed.
Partner will: ask what is wrong and for how long; ask simple follow-up questions about fever, pain, and other symptoms; give basic advice or next steps.
Not in this scene: booking the appointment, choosing a time, receptionist questions, buying medicine.
